title: Build banded list and controls
description:
js/ui/list.js renderList(root, bands) with a heading per band. js/ui/controls.js renderControls(root, store, days): day picker (dates from forecast), in-season toggle, access exclude (Ferry, 4x4, Kayak), country, tag filter, set-home input. Controls only call store.set.

Acceptance: changing day or filter re-renders without a network request; screenshot attached.

From docs/plans/0001-hiker-web-app.md, sections "Components > ui", "Key Flows > App state".

comments.author: Claude
comments.text: Done: day, in-season, country, avoid, tags, home. Changing day/filters made 0 network requests.
